reviewer: Codex assistant, November 8, 2026; not a human annotator
scope: All 16 new findings on four complete README pages, plus combined-event review against the unchanged 17-finding control

findings.rationale: The feature bullet compares uptime against unspecified competing servers across broad outage classes; the named fallback mechanisms do not establish that categorical comparison.
The modular architecture is concrete, but anything without bloat is an unbounded capability and overhead claim; the control already identified this defect.
Dependency independence does not establish universal platform compatibility; the concrete no-libc point is preserved.
The Go-language-versus-server comparison is ill-formed; the control already identified it.
The item promises more to discover while linking to the same features page already linked in the heading; it contributes no feature.
The absolute ranking against every other web server lacks a comparative measure; the control already identified this frozen event.
The proposed diagnosis correctly targets the unsupported vast-improvements comparison, but does not explicitly address ridiculously extensible, so it remains only partial event credit.
The sentence repeats the full-documentation heading and merely introduces the adjacent URL; removing it preserves access to the docs.
The sponsorship appeal is subjective promotion; the page cannot establish the predicted audience reaction, but a maintainer may intentionally retain that pitch.
This is external sponsor copy. The page does not establish exclusivity or universal package coverage, but the reviewer cannot determine whether the sponsor supplied and requires this wording.
The blanket endorsement adds no concrete criterion before the design principles; the control already identified this frozen event.
Nobody is an unsupported universal claim about user behavior; the preceding easy-principle text gives a more appropriately qualified motivation.
The claim infers application support for every Go target merely from implementation language; the named supported platforms should be retained while the universal inference is checked or narrowed.
All features effectively is broad, but in this documentation invitation it may be ordinary purpose language rather than an independently useful correction.
The summary question and invitation delay the screenshot label without adding a condition. This complements the control's accepted grammar diagnosis at the same source location.

The consolidation claim is framed around support for several data formats and backends. It may be a legitimate scoped benefit; the source does not establish whether removing all other agents is required in every relevant deployment.

events.rationale: Both streams identify the unsupported universal server comparison at the exact sentence.
Both streams diagnose the unsupported comparison, but neither calls out the unsupported ridiculously extensible intensifier required by the frozen event.
Both streams identify the blanket endorsement before the principles list.
The new restic finding identifies the exact absolute nobody claim and preserves the qualified performance rationale.
Neither stream targets easiest, fastest, and most painless in the project-purpose sentence.
The control identifies the malformed phrase and the new pass diagnoses the redundant rhetorical lead, together covering the frozen composite event.
Neither stream diagnoses the bullet that repeats its Performant label without a concrete performance property.
The control identifies the subject-verb disagreement; the new pass is not needed for this event.

review_note: Previously reviewed control findings and frozen labels are unchanged. All 16 new delivered findings remain in the acceptance denominator, including possible duplicates and uncertain findings. One source-bound finding is not necessarily an independently useful correction.
